notes:
What's new

- Portable copies are detected: they offer the portable download instead of quietly installing a second copy.
- Updates clean up after themselves — old helper copies and downloaded installers are removed from the temp folder.
- The update window sizes its buttons to their labels, so longer actions are never clipped.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.9 - portable copy detection (portable download instead of installing a second copy), automatic cleanup of stale update helpers/installers in %TEMP%, and self-sizing action buttons in the update window.
